items.title: Optional banner blur
items.text: Turn on “Blur my banner behind my profile” in your profile editor. Your banner is stretched, blurred and faded into your card theme.

items.title: New checkboxes
items.text: Every checkbox in Aduna now has the same rounded look, in your theme’s colors.

items.title: Smoother update notes
items.text: Update notes are now prepared for every release, so What’s new stays complete and up to date.

items.title: New minigame: Contexto
items.text: Open the + menu, pick Minigames, then Contexto. Guess the secret word of the day by meaning: every word you try gets a number, and the closer its meaning, the lower the number. 1 is the word itself.

items.title: Play on your own or with a server
items.text: Aduna has its own daily word, and every server gets one of its own with standings for its members. Use a hint if you are stuck, give up to see the word, and share your result into any chat.

items.title: Faster first Wordle guess
items.text: Wordle’s word list is now ready before you play, so your first guess no longer takes a moment to check.

items.title: Contexto keeps your cursor
items.text: After you press Enter on a guess in Contexto, you can keep typing without clicking the box again.

title: Tag channels, to-do lists and goals

items.title: Tag a channel with #
items.text: Type # in a server chat and pick a channel. It shows as a chip in the message, and clicking it takes you straight to that channel. It keeps working if the channel is renamed.

items.title: To-do channels
items.text: A new channel type for a shared task list. Owners choose which roles can add tasks, tasks can be given to a role, and the people holding that role can tick them off.

items.title: Goals channels
items.text: A new channel type where the owner sets goals with progress bars or checkboxes, and everyone in the server can follow how they are going.

items.title: Server templates
items.text: Start a new server from a ready-made template with channels and roles already set up, for example a business or a community.

title: Webhooks, smarter bots and a name checker

items.title: Server webhooks
items.text: Server managers can create a secret web address that other services post to. A webhook can drop a message in a text channel or hand its data to one of the server's bots. There is a generic JSON kind and a GitHub kind for push events.

items.title: Bots hear webhooks
items.text: Bots can now react to data that arrives through a webhook of their server, so a bot can post build results or alerts in its own words.

items.title: Bots see reactions
items.text: Bots can now react when someone adds a reaction to a message, in addition to messages, joins, leaves and timers.

items.title: Name checker
items.text: Usernames, display names, bios and server names are checked. If one is not appropriate you get a warning in the app and 3 days from the moment you see it to change it.

items.title: Themes tab in Explorer
items.text: Explorer has a new Themes tab for browsing themes.

items.title: Pictures and banners for bots
items.text: Bot developers can now give a bot a picture and a wide banner in Settings > Developer. The banner shows on the bot’s page and on its profile.

items.title: Long description for bots
items.text: A bot can have a longer description of up to 1,500 characters, with line breaks, to explain what it does and how to use it.

items.title: Bot pages in Explorer
items.text: On the Bots tab, bots now show their banner and picture. Press Read more, or a bot’s name, to open its page and add it to a server.

items.title: Longer messages with Aduna Plus
items.text: Aduna Plus members can write messages up to 4,000 characters instead of 2,000. A counter appears in the message box as you get close to the limit.

title: Zoom while you share your screen

items.title: Zoom in on your cursor
items.text: In the Aduna desktop app, while you share your whole screen, press Ctrl + Alt + Shift + Z to zoom the shared picture in on your cursor. Press it again to zoom back out. Scroll while zoomed in to zoom even closer. You still see your normal screen; only the people watching see the zoom.

items.title: Pick your own shortcut
items.text: Don’t like the shortcut? Change it in Settings > Voice & Video. It has to include Ctrl, Alt or Win so normal typing is never affected.

items.title: Clearer checkout
items.text: The checkout now says plainly that payments are handled securely by PayPal and that your card details go straight to PayPal, never to Aduna. Where sales tax applies, you can type your postal or ZIP code to find your tax region; the code itself stays in your browser.

items.title: Storage window tidy-up
items.text: The upload-limit choices for Aduna Plus now look right: normal capital letters, even spacing and proper radio buttons. The number box sits inside the “Set an upload limit” choice, and Save only turns on once you change something.

items.title: A bar you can read
items.text: The storage bar no longer looks empty on dark themes, and a small amount of use still shows a sliver. Under it you now see how much you have used and how much is free, or your upload limit if you set one.

items.title: Member goal on the home page
items.text: The Aduna home page now shows how many people have joined and how close we are to our goal of 1,000 members.

items.title: Unsafe links are hidden
items.text: Links that look dangerous, such as lookalike addresses, link shorteners and program downloads, now show as “Link hidden: looks unsafe”. Press “Show anyway” to see the real address first and decide for yourself. This also works in direct messages and group chats.

items.title: Known bad sites are blocked
items.text: Addresses on Aduna’s block list can’t be opened from a message at all. Creators can add to the list from the admin page and the change shows up right away.

items.title: Warnings from moderators
items.text: If a moderator warns you, you see it when you open Aduna and have to press “I understand” before you can send messages again. Warnings count for 90 days. The third is a 24-hour mute and the fifth is a 7-day suspension.

title: Pay for storage with a saved card

items.title: Card on file for the storage plan
items.text: You can now pay for the Aduna Plus storage plan with a card that PayPal keeps for you. It renews once a month, and you can cancel it any time in the Storage window. Aduna never sees your card number.

items.title: Easier card form
items.text: The card form in checkout has bigger fields and no extra border inside the box, and it highlights the field you are typing in. This applies to the storage plan and to buying credits.

title: New credit packs and prices in Canadian dollars

items.title: New credit packs
items.text: Credits now come in four packs: 500, 1,350, 2,900 and 6,200. The bigger the pack, the more extra credits you get for your money.

items.title: Pay in Canadian or US dollars
items.text: Pick your country and province or state at checkout. People in Canada see prices and pay in Canadian dollars, and people in the US pay in US dollars. The price you see already includes PayPal's fee, so checkout shows one price.

items.title: Canada and the US only for now
items.text: Credits and the Aduna Plus storage plan can only be bought from Canada or the US at the moment. Storage is now $7.69 a month in Canadian dollars, and the US price follows the exchange rate.

items.title: New pack sizes
items.text: Credits now come in packs of 500, 1,000, 2,500 and 5,000. They cost $2.49, $3.99, $7.69 and $10.89 in Canadian dollars. The US price follows the exchange rate.

title: Card form fix for US checkout

items.title: Card form after switching country
items.text: Switching between Canada and the US at checkout could leave the card form stuck on an error. The card boxes now load for either country.

title: Back button on phones and a voice bar above storage

items.title: Back works on phones
items.text: On a phone, Back now closes a window first, then the member list, then the chat, which takes you to the channel list. It no longer closes the app.

items.title: Voice bar above storage
items.text: While you are in a voice channel, a Voice Connected bar sits above the storage bar in the sidebar. Press it to go back to the channel, or press the phone button to leave. On phones the floating chip only shows while the sidebar is hidden.

items.title: Attachments stay until space runs out
items.text: Attachments are no longer deleted after a set number of days. They only go when space is needed: the oldest files of people without Aduna Plus make room for new uploads.

items.title: Creators can message anyone
items.text: Creator accounts can now start a direct message with people who are not their friends. The other person can reply once a creator has written first.

items.title: Reconnect notice fixed
items.text: The offline and reconnecting notice is now centered, and its Retry button stays inside the notice.

title: Aduna Plus card, lower price and more credits

items.title: Aduna Plus card
items.text: The Storage window and the bottom of the Shop now show everything Aduna Plus includes, with the price and a button to get it or manage your plan.

items.title: Lower price
items.text: Aduna Plus is now $5.59 a month in Canadian dollars, down from $7.69. The US price follows the exchange rate.

items.title: More credits with Plus
items.text: Plus members earn 1.5x the credits from quests. Messages pay 3 credits each for your first 60 a day, then 1 credit each until midnight UTC, with no daily cap.

items.title: Plus-only quests
items.text: Three new quests are for Plus members: Keep it going, Spread the love and A week of Plus. Everyone can see them, but only Plus members can claim them.

title: Plainer loading screen and Aduna Plus polish

items.title: Simpler loading screen
items.text: The loading screen now shows just the Aduna logo and name. The rings and the progress bar are gone.

items.title: Checkout says Aduna Plus
items.text: Checkout and PayPal now call the monthly plan Aduna Plus instead of Aduna Storage.

items.title: Sharper Plus logo
items.text: The Aduna Plus logo on the Plus card is cleaner, and it uses a brighter color on dark themes.

items.title: Clearer Plus perks
items.text: The list of what Aduna Plus includes is reworded to be shorter and easier to read.
